candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Technical Specification - Grid data
verified_facts: ASCII Terrain50 is a 200 by 200 raster grid for each 10km tile.
The first six rows are the ASCII data header.
Each data row reads west to east and successive rows progress 50m south.
Each height value is calculated from the centre of a 50m by 50m pixel.
semantic_limits: Header/index semantics identify the correct cell location but do not provide the current July 2026 elevation value without the actual archive bytes.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Technical Specification
verified_facts: Grid data is supplied as 10km by 10km tiles.
Tiles are identified by the National Grid reference of the south-west corner.
semantic_limits: Tile naming and spacing do not substitute for current cell values.

candidates.name: GDAL AAIGrid -- Arc/Info ASCII Grid driver
verified_facts: GDAL AAIGrid is built in by default and supports read access.
The driver reads affine georeferencing and can use an associated .prj file.
semantic_limits: Parser capability does not prove a particular downloaded archive is current or valid.

candidates.name: rasterio.mask module
verified_facts: all_touched=True includes a pixel if it touches the polygon.
With all_touched=False the default is pixel-centre/Bresenham selection.
semantic_limits: all_touched determines selection only; it does not change the OS Terrain50 pixel-centre height semantics.
